sources.title: A new species of Gryposaurus from the Kaiparowits Formation, Gates and Sampson2007
sources.supports: RAM6797 mostly articulated skull missing most right side; genus high nasal arch, robust deep skull, steep premaxilla. Partial referred postcrania separately listed.
sources.rights: Primary paper citation; no figure embedded.

sources.title: Gryposaurus monumentensis, Natural History Museum of Utah
sources.supports: Up to12m estimate, robust species, steep anterior beak, facultative quadruped; no measured specimen dimensions asserted.
